description: Read a bounded byte range from a Forgejo v16+ workflow job's plaintext log. Omitting offset returns the tail. Continue backward with previous_offset and previous_max_bytes, or forward with next_offset.

attempt.description: 1-based job attempt; omit for the latest attempt

max_bytes.description: Maximum log bytes to return (default 32768, maximum 262144)

offset.description: 0-based byte offset; omit to return the tail of the log

name: get_action_job_logs
